prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” attorney for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your specific facts (how bad the injuries are, who was at fault, insurers involved, whether you’ll need a trial, your budget, and where in Chicago you are). That said, Chicago has several highly respected plaintiff personal-injury firms with lots of car-accident experience:

- Clifford Law Offices — long-established, handles serious injury and wrongful-death auto cases.  
- Corboy & Demetrio — major plaintiffs’ trial firm, known for large verdicts and complex injury work.  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard — experienced trial lawyers in severe-injury auto and catastrophic-loss claims.  
- Power Rogers & Smith — Chicago firm that focuses on personal injury and car-accident claims.  
- Cooney & Conway — plaintiffs’ personal-injury firm with substantial auto-accident practice.

Those are examples of reputable firms, but a smaller boutique lawyer can be a better fit in many cases.

How to pick the best attorney for your case
- Look for trial experience and record of settlements/verdicts in car-accident cases.  
- Check credentials and peer/client reviews (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Google reviews).  
- Ask about contingency fees (commonly 33%–40%), who will handle the case day-to-day, and whether they’ll take your case to trial if needed.  
- Confirm they handle cases like yours (soft-tissue vs. catastrophic injury, multiple defendants, uninsured motorist, hit-and-run).  
- Get a free consultation — most Chicago PI firms offer them.

Urgent practical things
- Illinois generally has a 2-year statute of limitations for personal-injury claims (exceptions apply; government defendants require short notice periods), so contact a lawyer promptly.  
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report, witness info.

If you want, tell me:
- the neighborhood/ZIP code, the nature of the injuries, whether the other driver was at fault/insured, and how long since the crash — I can then shortlist 3–5 highly rated Chicago attorneys or firms and pull contact/rating info for you.
